name: Kiduja India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Kiduja India Ltd is in the business of Investments and dealing in Shares and Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Comapny used to be a data processing and software development firm by the name of Venus Computers Ltd. At present, it is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Finance Company which acts as a multi-disciplinary asset manager in broad range of activities such as futures and options trading, derivatives, a spot market stock portfolio and mutual fund investments

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
